project_type: React Native / Expo cross-platform app (iOS, Android, Web)
build_system: Expo SDK 52 with expo-router, Metro bundler
build_command: npx expo start (dev) — no dedicated build-check command
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npx vitest --run` for unit tests. 2. Manual verification: start app with `npx expo start`, test on iOS simulator, Android emulator, and web browser. 3. Verify animations are smooth (60fps), respect reduced motion settings, and work on all platforms.
environment_constraints: No native code ejection — all native code via Expo managed workflow. react-native-reanimated requires babel plugin (already configured via babel-preset-expo). Web uses CSS transitions as fallback for some Reanimated features.
contribution_requirements: Follow makeStyles(tokens) pattern for all styling. Never hardcode colors — use useTheme().tokens. Animations must respect useMotion() reduced motion settings. Components must work on iOS, Android, and web.
key_patterns: Existing motion components in src/components/motion/ (FadeInView, PressableScale, AnimatedGlow). useMotion() hook provides spring/timing configs and reduced motion detection. Use Reanimated useSharedValue, useAnimatedStyle, withSpring, withTiming. Import Animated from react-native-reanimated (not react-native).
directory_structure: app/ contains Expo Router screens and layouts. src/components/ contains reusable components organized by domain (task/, navigation/, planner/, motion/). src/hooks/ contains custom hooks including useTheme, useMotion, useProgress. src/theme/tokens.ts defines design system tokens.
